probe_design_defects.detail: Every candidate was evaluated inside one envelope that called inv.IMultiply(T) after the inverse candidate. Direct step isolation later proved IMultiply itself raises 61836. C2 and C6 therefore contain false-negative candidate attribution: their recorded exception does not prove that Inverse/DISPID 9 failed.
pythoncom.DISPATCH_METHOD equals 1, identical to makepy wFlags=1. C5 duplicates C1 and C6 duplicates C2; the nominal six candidates represent only four distinct dispatch paths.
The receipt did not record elapsed_ms, the inverse return type, inverse ArrayData, or a point-coordinate round-trip residual. These fields remain null below and are not reconstructed.
